description: Baseline Review-by-Exception rule set for a downstream purification batch record.

rules.description: Actual value must be within the step's own tolerance of target.
Equipment must not be DOWN or DISCONFIGURED during the step.
Any operator comment on a step is routed to a reviewer.
UV280 absorbance on the chromatography step must stay within 0-2.5 AU.
No single step should run longer than 180 minutes without review.
The same user cannot both perform and review a step.
